summary: Adds customer details including name, address, and date of birth to the DB2 CUSTOMER table by creating a new customer entry. Handles commarea input validation, customer number generation, DB2 insert operations, and error handling with CICS linkage.
businessPurpose: To create a new customer record in the DB2 CUSTOMER table by capturing and storing customer personal and contact details, ensuring unique customer number generation, and coordinating with other programs for further processing.
outputs: New customer number assigned (DB2-CUSTOMERNUM-INT and CA-CUSTOMER-NUM)
Error messages written to TDQ via LGSTSQ if SQL or commarea errors occur
dependencies: EIB (CICS system fields for transaction, terminal, task, and commarea length)
externalPrograms: LGSTSQ (program to write error messages to TDQ)
cicsUsage: Uses CICS commands for ABEND on missing commarea, GET COUNTER to obtain unique customer number, LINK to other CICS programs (LGACVS01, LGACDB02, LGSTSQ), ASKTIME and FORMATTIME for error message timestamps, and RETURN to caller. Handles commarea validations and error handling within CICS environment.
batchProcessing: No batch processing details identified. The program operates as an online CICS transaction program.
suggestedMicroservice: Customer Management Microservice - Responsible for creating and managing customer profiles including validation, unique ID generation, and integration with downstream processing services.
assumptions: Customer data is passed via a CICS commarea with a defined structure (LGCMAREA).
Unique customer number generation relies on a CICS counter (GENAcount in GENApool).
DB2 CUSTOMER table schema matches the fields used in the SQL INSERT statement.
Error messages are handled synchronously and written to a transaction data queue (TDQ) via LGSTSQ.
The linked programs LGACVS01 and LGACDB02 perform additional processing related to the customer and security data.
The environment supports CICS and DB2 with EXEC SQL precompiler and relevant copybooks.
No batch or asynchronous processing is performed within this program.
